email_subject: Application - Digital Training Intern (Fragrance & Beauty, Benelux & Scandinavia)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Training Intern role within the Benelux & Scandinavia Training team at CHANEL. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I create and edit digital content, manage CMS platforms and use AI tools daily to make learning and communication more effective. I am fluent in English and comfortable working in Dutch, with a strong interest in developing my language skills further.

In my current freelance and agency work, I build and maintain websites, design visuals in Canva, write SEO content and use analytics to track performance. I enjoy collaborating with different teams and organising digital projects from start to finish. The opportunity to support Beauty Advisors and contribute to a blended learning approach within an international team genuinely excites me.

I would welcome the chance to bring my creativity, organisation and digital skills to CHANEL. Thank you for considering my application.

Warm regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Training Intern position within the Benelux & Scandinavia Training team at CHANEL. Your search for someone who can create digital mobile learnings, manage communication plans and design content for local training needs matches my daily work as a digital marketer with a technical background. I am fluent in English, comfortable in Dutch and eager to grow in a dynamic Fragrance & Beauty environment.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I build and optimise websites, write and publish content, and use creative tools such as Canva to design visuals and presentations. I manage CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify, track results with Google Analytics and Search Console, and use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks. These experiences have taught me to organise projects carefully, meet deadlines and communicate clearly with clients and team members.

What draws me to this internship is the blend of digital content creation, learning strategy and human interaction. I enjoy understanding what motivates people and turning that insight into useful, engaging materials. Supporting Beauty Advisors, maintaining contact with learning communities and helping to organise digital events are tasks I would approach with curiosity and responsibility. My background in computer science and front-end development also means I am quick to pick up new tools and platforms.

I would be delighted to contribute to CHANEL's training team, learn from experienced professionals and bring my creativity, autonomy and team spirit to the role. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your digital learning activities.

Warm regards,
